Experience in and ability to teach and supervise medical students , residents and fellows.
Musculoskeletal Imaging Radiologist Physician Remote/Hybrid

The Department of Radiology at UC Davis Health is seeking a highly skilled Musculoskeletal Imaging Radiologist to join our team as an ASC Physician Diplomat in a fully remote capacity. This role offers the opportunity to practice at a leading academic medical center while delivering high-quality, patient-centered imaging services across a diverse and complex clinical environment.
Possession of the legal requirements for the practice of medicine in CA as determined by the CA Board of Medical Quality Assurance.
Fellowship training in Radiology.
CA Medical Board Eligible.
Completion completed a residency program in Diagnostic Radiology at an accredited institution.
Meets the credentialing and privileging standards for UDCH medical staff.
Clinical expertise in all aspects of Musculoskeletal imaging including MR, CT, US, and image-guided procedures.
Possession of the legal requirements for the practice of medicine in CA as determined by the CA Board of Medical Quality Assurance.
Strong political and institutional acumen sufficient to accomplish needed action in a complex public research university environment.
Expertise in all aspects of Musculoskeletal imaging including MR, CT, US, and image - guided procedures.
Works at a computer terminal for extended periods of time.
At the title code 0771 - Associate Physician, must be ABR board eligible.
This position is a critical position and subject to a background check.
Meets the credentialing and privileging standards for UCDH medical staff.
Close Visual Acuity (e.g., viewing a computer screen; using measurement devices) – Constantly, Color Visual Acuity – constantly.
Outstanding leadership and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of University and campus policies and procedures preferred.
Skills to analyze needs, establishing priorities , and provide appropriate medical care and preventative medicine services in the Campus community.
Excellent oral and written communication skills including presentation skills in large and small group settings.
Knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
Computer and keyboarding skills to use Electronic Medical Records software program.
